mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", department AS "department", position AS "position", phone AS "phone", birth_date AS "birthDate", address AS "address", hire_date AS "hireDate", resign_date AS "resignDate", memo AS "memo", username AS "username", created_at AS "createdAt", resident_no_enc AS "residentNoEnc", permissions AS "permissions", COALESCE(is_admin, 0) AS "isAdmin" FROM employees ORDER BY department NULLS FIRST, name NULLS FIRST

SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", hire_date AS "hireDate", department AS "department", position AS "position", resign_date AS "resignDate", username AS "username", COALESCE(is_admin, 0) AS "isAdmin", resident_no_enc AS "residentNoEnc" FROM employees WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employees (id, name, created_at, department, position, phone, birth_date, address, hire_date, resign_date, memo, resident_no_enc, username, password_hash) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{now}, #{department, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{position, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{birthDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{hireDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resignDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{residentNoEnc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{username, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{passwordHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE username = #{username} AND id <> #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE COALESCE(is_admin, 0) = 1 AND username IS NOT NULL AND id <> #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET username = NULL, password_hash = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_login_account (tenant_id, login_code, password_hash, use_at) SELECT t.tenant_id, e.id, e.password_hash, 'Y' FROM employees e JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} WHERE e.id = #{id} ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, login_code) DO UPDATE SET password_hash = EXCLUDED.password_hash, use_at = 'Y', updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO tb_login_account_role (login_id, role_id) SELECT la.login_id, r.role_id FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = la.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} JOIN tb_role r ON r.tenant_id = la.tenant_id AND r.role_code = 'DEFAULT_USER' WHERE la.login_code = #{id} ON CONFLICT (login_id, role_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO tb_user (tenant_id, login_id, user_nm, email_addr, use_at) SELECT la.tenant_id, la.login_id, e.name, CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(e.email), '') IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_user u2 WHERE u2.tenant_id = la.tenant_id AND u2.email_addr = BTRIM(e.email)) THEN NULL ELSE BTRIM(e.email) END, CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(e.resign_date), '') IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = la.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} JOIN employees e ON e.id = la.login_code WHERE la.login_code = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id AND u.login_id = la.login_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user u SET user_nm = e.name, use_at = CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(e.resign_date), '') IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = la.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} JOIN employees e ON e.id = la.login_code WHERE la.login_code = #{id} AND u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id AND u.login_id = la.login_id
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", department AS "department", position AS "position", hire_date AS "hireDate", resign_date AS "resignDate" FROM employees ORDER BY department NULLS FIRST, name NULLS FIRST
SELECT employee_id AS "employeeId", leave_date AS "leaveDate", COALESCE(days, 0) AS "days" FROM leave_records
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(days), 0) FROM leave_records WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND leave_date = #{leaveDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_records (employee_id, leave_date, days, note, created_at, created_by) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{leaveDate}, #{days}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{now}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
